summary: Clearwater County lookout 12 miles ENE of Bovill with a run of crow's nest, cabin, platform and tower structures from 1914; destroyed in 1969.

facts.design: 74-foot L-6 tower, the last structure in the record
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1969; no source describes what remains

visit.trail_note: No source describes access to the site today

events.note: Destroyed; the record gives no cause

evidence.quote: the present 53' treated timber tower with L-4 cab was built in 1954

evidence.supports: Separate lookout on the Clearwater National Forest

sources.title: Hemlock Butte Fire Lookout Tower (staffed lookout)

notes_for_editor: One source gives the full chronology for this tower, and it is a short record. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page for the gone tower returned a 404 in the cache, so it is not cited. Do not merge this record with the standing Hemlock Butte (46.47352, -115.62924, US 767 ID 57). That lookout has a 1921 cupola, a 1934 50-foot pole L-4 and a 1954 tower, and the NHLR and Idaho Fire Lookouts histories describe it, not this one. No photos or present-day site evidence were found.
